The top five medical device companies in the world by annual revenue are Medtronic, Johnson & Johnson MedTech, Abbott, Medline Industries, and Siemens Healthineers. These industry leaders generate billions of dollars annually by providing essential surgical tools, diagnostic systems, and patient care technology. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

- **Medtronic**: Generates over $36 billion; focuses on cardiac care, surgical robots, and neurological devices.

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech**: Brings in around $33.8 billion; known for orthopedic implants, advanced surgery tools, and vision products.

- **Abbott Laboratories**: Collects about $30.3 billion in device and diagnostic sales; famous for the FreeStyle Libre glucose monitor

- **Medline Industries**: Earns roughly $28.4 billion; a massive supplier of everyday hospital consumables and medical surgical products.

- **Siemens Healthineers**: Reaches $27 billion in medical tech; a powerhouse in diagnostic imaging, MRI machines, and laboratory diagnostics. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)
